tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find electronics sold in Lebanon and their live prices across Lebanese shops (USD, re-checked nightly). Returns up to 10 products, most widely sold first, each with its lowest price, how many shops sell it, and its LebTech page. Laptops also carry model_page: every CPU/GPU variant of that model with

tools.name: get_product_prices
tools.description: Live per-shop prices for ONE product in Lebanon: every shop that has the identical configuration in stock, cheapest first, with links to the shop's own product page. Takes a LebTech product id or a lebtechlb.com /product/ or /laptop/ URL.

tools.name: cheapest_in_category
tools.description: The cheapest products currently in stock in a category in Lebanon (laptops: cheapest among sensible, new machines first). Optional budget and brand. Up to 10 results.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: How the lowest price of one product across Lebanese shops moved over the last ~90 days: current low, period low/high, the drop since tracking began, and weekly lows. Takes a LebTech product id or a lebtechlb.com /product/ or /laptop/ URL.
